decision.summary: The screened E-ramp (490–544) is a sustained upward trend without matching coherent N/U motion; however, it lacks a clear opposing return within the allowed context [455,579], and no discrete temporary offset (i.e., onset + sustained interior + return) is observed. The later coupled E-up/U-down trend (starting ~520) extends beyond the allowed context and shows no return before index 579. No candidate temporary offsets meet the criteria of confirmed onset, sustained interior, and unambiguous opposing return on the affected axes. Missing observations (e.g., indices 545–548) prevent verification of return behavior. Thus, no temporary offset intervals are confirmed or even uncertainly supported.
